notes.title: Field Hospital Lore and Spring Sale
notes.content:
Greetings!

It's time for our spring sale! We're excited to offer a 60% discount. So, if you've been contemplating whether to buy the game or not, now is the best time to do it. 

Recently, Ukrainian blogger Emma Pustelia shared with us the idea of creating a video dedicated to the universe of the Field Hospital. We lovingly told her various facts, lore and secrets related to the game. The video turned out great, so we now want to share it with everyone who has fallen in love with and is interested in the world of Field Hospital. The video is in Ukrainian, but there are English subtitles as well. Enjoy:

[previewyoutube=QjSbChm0rYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

However, we must announce that we are ceasing all work on the Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story. It has been a wonderful time, over three years of enjoyable experience. We were thrilled to see the first sales, hear the first comments on YouTube, and read the first reviews of our game. It gave us the motivation to create and improve the product. Throughout this time, we tried to listen to our audience and fix bugs promptly. We wanted to expand the game and provide more opportunities for players. But everything comes to an end eventually. 

Now, we have shifted our focus to another project, dedicating most of our free time to its creation. This means you'll soon see another game from us, which we hope will bring you many hours of unforgettable gameplay. 

Stay with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/2c228fb32755fea8415abdde43df578fc5003eba.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sich Tactics Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After a prolonged silence, we want to share some good news.

We are once again entering the active phase of development. We are working on interesting mechanics to diversify the gameplay.

Let's lift the veil a little. Since the Cossacks were famous for their cunning and ingenuity, we want to convey this through game mechanics. For example, we are developing a system of interaction between characters controlled by the player, which will add more in-depth tactical decisions. We will try to achieve such a result that the interaction of combat units among themselves brings more benefit. But let’s not spoil the dessert and leave it for later.

Also, intensive work is currently underway with graphics, namely the creation of new characters, development of animations, user interface, and so on.

There will be more news about the project soon, so add it to the wishlist and follow the development of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064100/Sich_Tactics/

And while you wait for the news, we present to you the main theme music of Sich Tactics.

[previewyoutube=33Xpw4ozqCM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sich Tactics | Announcement
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! We've been thinking for a while what to do after the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1315120/view/3292706855591228565]big update of Field Hospital[/url] and decided... to make a new game!

So meet [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064100/Sich_Tactics/]SICH TACTICS[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/6ee74a3d85f0ba8a8fbbfbaa1ce7eefd4559c828.png[/img]

It is a small turn-based tactics in which you lead a party of Cossacks and fight chorts, muscovites and other unholy spirits of Ukrainian folklore.

Indeed, it is very different from Field Hospital, but we've always wanted to make games that we're interested in, experiment and create new things. And we love so many different genres.

Sich Tactics, like Field Hospital, is something we do in our free time and for fun. Therefore, you should not expect huge campaigns and stories. We focus on tactical battles and build the game in the rogue-lite paradigm, namely:
[list]
[*] procedural generation,
[*] variety of mechanics, opponents and game situations,
[*] progression between runs in the form of new classes of Cossacks
[/list]

In addition, the game will have a separate competitive mode with leaderboard, the details of which we will tell a little later.

In the meantime, add the game to Wishlist and subscribe for updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064100/Sich_Tactics/

notes.title: Ukrainian Indie Games Bundle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/744142fb121289ddc828044ff3e0deaa41292bea.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 

Hope you and your relatives feel safe. 

Because we don't.

As you know there is a war raging in Ukraine. It's our homeland. In the response to maleficent Russian invasion we already asked Steam support to make Field Hospital unavailable in Russia. 

Along with that we participate in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25237/Ukrainian_Indie_Games_Bundle/]Ukrainian Indie Games Bundle[/url]. There are 11 games from 11 Ukrainian developers. Some of them are safe now. Some are internally displaced. Others are refugees. But there is no one who is not affected by this war. That's why all of the earnings from this bundle are goes directly to developers (minus Steam cut). 

Most of the developers already announced that money will be donated to Ukraine's Armed Forces, humanitarian and volunteer organizations. Here you can find information on [url=https://www.supportukraine.co/]how to help Ukraine right now[/url].

We personally donate to [url=https://bank.gov.ua/en/news/all/natsionalniy-bank-vidkriv-spetsrahunok-dlya-zboru-koshtiv-na-potrebi-armiyi]Ukraine's Armed Forces[/url].

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization Beta starts today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/7ec9b6b6613ecaca8b47c252d1c8ef5f79161c76.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce that the Simplified Chinese Localization Beta starts today!

If you’ve signed up for beta via Google Form check your email for Steam Key and activate it. 

After activation (or if you have the game already) follow this simple steps:
[olist]
[*] Go to your [b]Steam Library[/b]
[*] Right-click on [b]Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].
[*] Go to the tab marked [b]Betas[/b].
[*] In the drop-down box, select [b]localization-beta[/b].
[*] Wait for the game to finish updating, you should see the branch name listed after the game name.
[*] In the game you may need to switch language to Simplified Chinese. Click on the [b]Settings [/b]and then click on the [b]Language [/b]field to switch between languages. [b]Apply [/b]your changes.
[*] You are ready to play :)
[/olist]

Use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1315120/discussions/2]Steam Forum[/url] to leave your feedback.

You may leave your feedback on localization in the [b]Localization Beta[/b] forum. Here are things to look at:
[list]
[*] [b]Localization of texts and terms[/b]. You may switch between languages at any time using the Settings menu to check English text for comparison.
[*] [b]Indents and their absence[/b]. 
[*] [b]Commas and dots at the beginning of the line[/b]. We are still looking for a solution but it requires some time. If you encounter commas or dots at the beginning of the line please take a screenshot and send us via Steam Forum.
[*] [b]Fonts size and alignment[/b]. If it’s easy to read and understand.
[*] [b]Anything you think is important to share[/b].
[/list]

If you’ve encountered a bug or any technical difficulties leave your report in the [b]Bug Reports and Technical Issues[/b] forum. If you want to share your feedback on the game itself or story feel free to use the general discussions forum. 

If you have any questions you may ask them right in the comments below.

Cheers!

notes.title: New Story Campaign Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all thanks to all of you who played and enjoyed our game. We are happy to read your reviews and watch letsplays. You are great! We'd like to share our plans for upcoming year with you. 

We are working on a new Campaign with completely new story and characters. It will also have new gameplay features. We want to experiment a bit with game feel and story. 

Here's quick Q&A:

[b]What its gonna be about?[/b] It's gonna be a secret for a while. But some of you may probably guess ;)

[b]When it will be released?[/b] 2021. Seriously. We can't say exact date or even estimated. Field Hospital is our passion project and it takes time to develop. We'll announce update release date as soon as we are sure about it.

[b]How much will it cost?[/b] New Campaign will be absolutely free. It's not a DLC. It's more like new game mode. We expect it to be longer and has bigger replay value. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/102f1009e714fa8935b5a34fb538cc7dd5a396f7.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more news and updates.

Also we're fixing some bugs, working on more features and correcting texts. We hope to launch global statistics feature soon.

If you liked our game we'd appreciate if you write a review. It helps a lot in making it visible for more players.

Good luck and Happy Holidays! 

Stay safe.

notes.title: On development progress
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’ve been dropped off of radars for a while now. So I decided to write this post to share current progress.

First, the game is still in active development. It’s not cancelled nor freezed. We’re working on it daily and are close to polishing stage. Almost all texts are written but they require final editing and check before sending to translation. 

Second, we’re two-guys team working on the game in our free time. We both have regular jobs and Field Hospital is our passion project. This implies that we have limited time and capacity to work on it. This is the reason we can’t afford enough time for marketing and PR activities. That’s why we don’t want to rush its release but to make it as good as we can. That takes us to...

Third, Field Hospital is a small game. Please, don’t expect too much. There are 37 characters, most of them are interconnected and share common story, some are independent. We design stories the way that everyone may find something personal among them. There is no placeholder character in the game that’s why their number is limited. Field Hospital is more narrative-driven rather than mechanics-oriented and gameplay is just a tool to explore stories and to make choices matter. The game is short but rely on non-linearity and replayability. 

Fourth, we want the game to be as accessible as possible so we developed a localization pipeline for Field Hospital. It will be available in English, Russian and Ukrainian at release. We’re planning to translate it to other languages in several stages after release. First stage will include French, German and Spanish. Other languages will come after.

We want to thank everyone who wishlisted the game. It means a lot to us and we’ll do our best to don’t disappoint you.

Stay safe.

Nick from Gard Interactive
